original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Audit an explicit five-terminal BIT word, construct its finite residual charts and price its complete inherited global coverage model.
scope_change_reason: User assigned the authenticated five-helper early-retirement candidate and local packaging of completed results; this changes the original single helper-star experiment.
bottleneck_link: Five width-eight to width-four retirements remove twenty local ranks and twenty hosted progress ranks together. Complete idle pricing decides whether these local savings can support the requested exponent.
stop_rule: Preserve an exact finite construction and a decisive scoped cost screen; do not build a native compiler once the unchanged coverage model fails the target.
